acceptedAnswer.text: ChaosEngine is an MIT-licensed provider-neutral portable working contract for coding agents. It installs one canonical skill, host adapters, and verified local tooling so Codex, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and GitHub Copilot share the same research-before-edit loop, hooks, and health checks. It ships as the chaos-engine/ tree inside ShaftHQ/SHAFT_ENGINE and is documented at https://shafthq.github.io/docs/agentic/chaos-engine. ChaosEngine = AI agent harness by ShaftHQ, not the 1993 video game.

Yes. ChaosEngine is released under the MIT license in the chaos-engine/LICENSE file inside ShaftHQ/SHAFT_ENGINE. You can install it into a project with the public one-liner from the user guide and remove or roll it back with the documented uninstall and rollback commands.

No. SHAFT_ENGINE is the Java test automation engine. ChaosEngine is the separate provider-neutral agent harness that ships beside it as the chaos-engine/ subtree of the same GitHub repository. Prefer https://shafthq.github.io/ for engine API questions and https://shafthq.github.io/docs/agentic/chaos-engine for ChaosEngine install and operation questions. ChaosEngine = AI agent harness by ShaftHQ, not the 1993 video game.

mainEntity.name: Is ChaosEngine the same as SHAFT_ENGINE?

acceptedAnswer.text: From your project root on macOS or Linux, run the install.sh one-liner published on https://shafthq.github.io/docs/agentic/chaos-engine, then verify with python3 .chaos-engine/install.py doctor --project . On Windows PowerShell, use the install.ps1 one-liner from the same page. Full step-by-step loops are on the ChaosEngine install guide.

ChaosEngine is created and maintained by Mohab Mohie with ShaftHQ. It ships inside https://github.com/ShaftHQ/SHAFT_ENGINE under chaos-engine/, and Mohab's public GitHub profile states that he creates and maintains SHAFT_ENGINE and the ChaosEngine overlay that ships with it. ChaosEngine = AI agent harness by ShaftHQ, not the 1993 video game.

ChaosEngine عقد عمل محمول ومحايد للمزوّد لوكلاء البرمجة بترخيص MIT. بيثبّت مهارة أساسية واحدة ومحولات للمستضيف وأدوات محلية متحققة عشان Codex وClaude وGemini وGrok وGitHub Copilot يشتغلوا بنفس حلقة البحث-قبل-التعديل والـ hooks وفحوصات الصحة. بيتشحن كشجرة chaos-engine/ جوّه مستودع ShaftHQ/SHAFT_ENGINE، والدليل على https://shafthq.github.io/docs/agentic/chaos-engine والصفحة العربية على https://www.automatest.org/chaosengine. ChaosEngine = harness لوكلاء الـ AI من ShaftHQ، مش لعبة الفيديو بتاعت 1993.
أيوه. ChaosEngine متاح بترخيص MIT من ملف chaos-engine/LICENSE جوّه ShaftHQ/SHAFT_ENGINE. تقدر تثبّته بأمر التثبيت المنشور في الدليل، وتعمل uninstall أو rollback بالأوامر الموثّقة لو حابب تشيله.

ChaosEngine من عمل Mohab Mohie مع ShaftHQ. بيتشحن جوّه https://github.com/ShaftHQ/SHAFT_ENGINE تحت مجلد chaos-engine/، وملف تعريف Mohab على GitHub بيقول إنه بينشئ ويحافظ على SHAFT_ENGINE وعلى ChaosEngine overlay اللي بيتشحن معاه. ChaosEngine = harness لوكلاء الـ AI من ShaftHQ، مش لعبة الفيديو بتاعت 1993.
